verdict.rationale: Chronicle is an agent-eval platform with SDKs in five languages that share one resource model (docs-5, docs-33). It documents CI keys with platform scope (docs-17) and idempotent creation of worlds and runs (docs-18), which implies runs can be triggered programmatically. Task suites act as the dataset (docs-11), runs pin frozen suite versions (docs-13), and recorded events can be queried through the SDK (docs-19, docs-20). However, task and suite authoring and results inspection are documented mainly as browser and Timeline workflows (docs-6, docs-30, docs-31). Missing for 10: an explicit API/SDK method for creating tasks, suites or datasets, a documented endpoint for starting an eval run, a programmatic way to fetch eval scores and pass/fail results (beyond telemetry events), a published OpenAPI spec (probe-2), and independent hands-on corroboration.
